entries.4166194543c8e5a8: A company headquartered in Hachioji, Tokyo, that operates Japanese and Western dinner restaurants and the Western confectionery shop 'Atelier Ukai'.
entries.515945304a3a0801: It operates eight restaurants: teppan-grilled cuisine at “Hachioji Ukai-tei,” “Yokohama Ukai-tei,” “Ginza Ukai-tei,” “Azamino Ukai-tei,” “Omotesando Ukai-tei” and “Roppongi Ukai-tei”; grill cuisine at “Grill Ukai Marunouchi”; and brasserie cuisine at “Le Pūre Brasserie Ukai.”
entries.54803cd9b0552b64: A business operating dinner restaurants: five Japanese restaurants and eight Western-style restaurants.
entries.78fe053b2d08396a: This is a business that develops, manufactures and sells Western-style confectionery at the 5 stores of the confectionery shop "Atelier Ukai". It has stores at Torie Keio Chofu, which has an attached confectionery workshop, as well as at Ekyuto Shinagawa, Takashimaya Kyoto and Takashimaya Osaka, and GranSta Tokyo, and also carries out EC sales and event stores at department stores. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,994 million.
entries.9cf94fe9e1935c99: A store brand that manufactures and sells Western-style confectionery.
entries.b7d7934619ed0323: It operates five restaurants: “Ukai Toriyama” (irori charcoal-grilled cuisine), “Tofuya Ukai Owada and Saginuma branches” (tofu cuisine), and “Ginza kappou ukai Nikusho” and “Roppongi kappou ukai” (kaiseki cuisine). “Tokyo Shiba Tofuya Ukai” closed on March 31, 2026, upon expiry of its contract period.
entries.ba0950ec1956bdc4: It operates five restaurants: “Ukai Toriyama” (irori charcoal-grilled cuisine), “Tofuya Ukai Owada and Saginuma branches” (tofu cuisine), and “Ginza kappou ukai Nikusho” and “Roppongi kappou ukai” (kaiseki cuisine).
entries.ed1c637e903e586d: This is a store brand that manufactures and sells Western-style confectionery. It operates stores with attached confectionery workshops and stores in department stores and station buildings, and also carries out long-term events at department stores and EC sales.
entries.fbbdeebd82697824: A business operating dinner restaurants: five Japanese restaurants and eight Western-style restaurants. For Japanese cuisine, it operates “Ukai Toriyama” (irori charcoal-grilled cuisine), “Tofuya Ukai” (tofu cuisine) and “kappou ukai” (kaiseki cuisine); for Western cuisine, it operates “Ukai-tei” (teppan-grilled cuisine) and others. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,022 million.
